nodes.name: build-exe.ps1
nodes.summary: Builds the one-file windowed ZaloBot.exe with PyInstaller from the project venv, scans the build output for leaked secrets, and optionally copies the exe to the project root.

nodes.name: install-task.ps1
nodes.summary: Registers Windows Task Scheduler tasks that launch the bot and the admin UI at logon via run-forever.ps1, with auto-restart settings.

nodes.name: run-forever.ps1
nodes.summary: Supervisor loop that runs the bot or admin UI via python -m bot, logs exits, and restarts after 10 seconds unless the exit code means config error, lock held, or standby.
nodes.languageNotes: Exit codes 2, 3 and 5 are treated as terminal; any other exit triggers a restart.

nodes.name: uninstall-task.ps1
nodes.summary: Stops and unregisters the bot and admin scheduled tasks and kills leftover python bot processes.
